CD.CDComment:
Content Dictionary for the K'UHUL Fold Graph semantic contract. Defines FoldPair and its structural constraints as formalised in vectors.mml and fold_graph.xml.
Key invariant (no-pattern-inflation): |supp M[Y,·]| = #{X ∈ S : Y ∈ C_X} FoldPair increases operator surface; it does not increase |X|.
Notation: M_{Y,X} = co-occurrence/association mass (forward matrix). Do not conflate with W_Y = runtime selection weight (static_weight in WCR). M and W are distinct; they feed different pipeline stages.

CDDefinition.Name: FoldPair
CDDefinition.Description:
FoldPair(S) = ⟨ M_{Y,X}, C_{Y,X}^T ⟩
Returns a logical pair of accumulation matrices over the shared semantic axis X ∈ S. The pair is a semantic contract, not a physical memory layout.
Arguments: S — semantic position set (the X axis; fixed by the topology map)
Result members: M_{Y,X} — forward (membership) co-occurrence mass matrix: M[Y][X] += 1 if Y ∈ C_X, else 0. NOT the WCR runtime selection weight W_Y (static_weight). C_{Y,X}^T — reverse (traversal) matrix, transposed: C[Y][X] += 1 for each Y ∈ C_X
Shared axis: X (both members indexed over the same S)
Physical lowering to [ M ; C^T ] is optional and backend-chosen. This symbol asserts only the logical pair.

property.description: Shared-axis constraint: no pattern inflation
FoldPair does not lower to a concatenated matrix. Physical backends may choose [M; C^T] but this symbol does not assert it.
Direction asymmetry is intentional: M uses membership test (indicator); C uses traversal (double quantifier). Both are correct update rules for the same underlying data.

CDDefinition.Name: FoldPairLower
CDDefinition.Description:
FoldPairLower( FoldPair(S) ) = [ M ; C^T ]
Optional physical lowering of a FoldPair to a contiguous stacked matrix. May only be applied when the physical backend requires vertical concatenation. Storage dimensions: (2·|Y|) × |X|.
This symbol is non-normative with respect to the semantic contract. The semantic contract is FoldPair; FoldPairLower is a projection.

property.description: semantic contract ≠ physical representation (fold_graph.xml law: representation-is-provider)

CDDefinition.Name: Axis
CDDefinition.Description:
Axis(name, set) declares a named semantic axis indexed over a set. Used to assert that two matrices share a coordinate system without implying physical adjacency.
Example: Axis("X", S) declares that both M_{Y,X} and C_{Y,X} are indexed by the same position set S.

CDDefinition.Name: supp
CDDefinition.Description: supp(v) — support of a vector v: the set of indices at which v is nonzero. Used in the no-pattern-inflation property of FoldPair: |supp M[Y,·]| = #{X ∈ S : Y ∈ C_X}.

CDDefinition.Name: setbuilder
CDDefinition.Description: setbuilder(x, domain_condition, filter_condition) — set-builder notation: { x | domain_condition AND filter_condition }. Used to express #{X ∈ S : Y ∈ C_X} in the shared-axis constraint.

CDDefinition.Name: PriorDistribution
CDDefinition.Description: PriorDistribution(θ) = Λ(θ). Antecedent distribution over latent semantic parameter states preserved by FoldGraph B. It supplies statistical context for VECTOR-µ representation decisions but does not verify semantic truth.

CDDefinition.Name: Probability
CDDefinition.Description: Probability(x, θ) = P(x | θ). Conditional probability of observing graph, typed-edge, telemetry, or episode evidence x under latent semantic state θ.

CDDefinition.Name: Loss
CDDefinition.Description: Loss(θ, a) = L(θ,a). Penalty assigned when VECTOR-µ chooses derived geometric action a for true latent semantic state θ. Loss constrains projection admissibility; it is not a Ch'en proof.

CDDefinition.Name: Risk
CDDefinition.Description: Risk(θ, δ) = R(θ,δ) = E_{x|θ}[Loss(θ,δ(x))]. Expected loss of decision rule δ under latent semantic state θ.

CDDefinition.Name: DecisionRule
CDDefinition.Description: DecisionRule(δ, x) maps observed GML/Fold/Episode evidence x to a derived VECTOR-µ geometry action. A decision rule may be rejected as inadmissible before Ch'en/Xul admission, but it cannot mutate B by itself.

CDDefinition.Name: BayesRisk
CDDefinition.Description: BayesRisk(Λ, δ) = ∫ Risk(θ,δ) dΛ(θ). Integrated average risk under an antecedent prior distribution.

CDDefinition.Name: MinimaxRule
CDDefinition.Description: MinimaxRule chooses δ to minimize max_θ Risk(θ,δ). It protects VECTOR-µ from worst-case structural/geometric collapse and emits projection-rule rejection evidence, not topology mutation authority.

CDDefinition.Name: MinimaxRiskBound
CDDefinition.Description: MinimaxRiskBound is the local risk bound used to flag inadmissible vector rules when a loss_cost exceeds endpoint risk_bound constraints.

CDDefinition.Name: DeltaFieldDiff
CDDefinition.Description: DeltaFieldDiff = ΔF_diff = ⟨ ΔM_{Y,X}, ΔRelations, R_minimax ⟩. Captures differential NLP graph drift together with statistical risk constraints.

CDDefinition.Name: DeltaCooccurrenceMass
CDDefinition.Description: DeltaCooccurrenceMass(Y,X) = ΔM_{Y,X}. Co-occurrence mass delta observed between graph/text states. This remains semantic evidence, not WCR weight.

CDDefinition.Name: DeltaRelations
CDDefinition.Description: DeltaRelations is the typed relation-edge component of ΔF_diff or FoldDelta. It tracks structural relation drift and still requires Ch'en/Xul authority before any committed topology mutation.

CDDefinition.Name: GraphHamiltonian
CDDefinition.Description: GraphHamiltonian(ψ_e, U_e) = -d²ψ_e/dx² + U_e(x)ψ_e(x). Differential operator over a metric graph edge interval [0,L_e]. It governs derived VECTOR-µ/METRIC-µ wave geometry and does not redefine FoldGraph B.

CDDefinition.Name: IncidentEdges
CDDefinition.Description: IncidentEdges(v) returns the edge set E(v) adjacent to vertex v. Used for vertex boundary conditions and flux conservation on quantum graphs.

CDDefinition.Name: DerivativeAtVertex
CDDefinition.Description: DerivativeAtVertex(e,v) is the outward derivative ∂ψ_e/∂x evaluated at vertex v along edge e.

CDDefinition.Name: FluxConservation
CDDefinition.Description: FluxConservation(v): sum of outward edge derivatives at vertex v equals the localized vertex potential/selection term W_v ψ_v. This covers Kirchhoff/Robin matching as a projection invariant.

CDDefinition.Name: PlaneWaveSuperposition
CDDefinition.Description: PlaneWaveSuperposition(e,x) = A_e exp(i k_e x) + B_e exp(-i k_e x). Represents forward and reflected semantic wave amplitudes on a metric edge interval.

CDDefinition.Name: ScatteringMatrix
CDDefinition.Description: ScatteringMatrix(v,m,j) = 2/degree(v) - δ_mj under Kirchhoff/Neumann boundary conditions. It distributes incoming plane-wave amplitude at a vertex across adjacent channels.

CDDefinition.Name: KroneckerDelta
CDDefinition.Description: KroneckerDelta(m,j) = 1 when m=j, otherwise 0.

CDDefinition.Name: Degree
CDDefinition.Description: Degree(v) is the number of incident edge channels at vertex v.

CDDefinition.Name: FieldZeroes
CDDefinition.Description: FieldZeroes(V) returns isolated zeroes of vector field V. Used by the Poincare-Hopf consistency law for derived flow fields.

CDDefinition.Name: LocalIndex
CDDefinition.Description: LocalIndex(z,V) is the vector-field index at isolated zero z.

CDDefinition.Name: EulerCharacteristic
CDDefinition.Description: EulerCharacteristic(M) = χ(M), the topological invariant equaling the sum of local vector-field indices for admissible continuous reparameterizations.

CDDefinition.Name: GradientFlow
CDDefinition.Description:
GradientFlow(γ, V) asserts the integral curve ODE: γ'(t) = V(γ(t)).
Arguments: γ — smooth curve γ: ℝ → M on the semantic manifold M V — continuous vector field V: M → TM (tangent bundle)
The curve γ is the unique trajectory a semantic state follows when driven by field V. Existence and uniqueness follow from the Picard– Lindelöf theorem on M.
Completeness: a GradientFlow path is complete when its flow line propagates without reaching a structural boundary. Paths that terminate at a boundary (divergence sink or manifold edge) are incomplete and are flagged for Ch'en revalidation before Xul commits them.
Admissibility constraint: GradientFlow is derived geometry. It can propose a trajectory; it cannot mutate FoldGraph B. Ch'en/Xul retain exclusive commit authority.

property.description: Integral curve ODE: γ'(t) = V(γ(t))
Uniqueness: given initial condition γ(0) = p and a Lipschitz-continuous V, the integral curve through p is unique on M.

Completeness gate: GradientFlow is complete iff the flow line does not reach a structural sink (divergence < 0) or manifold boundary within the admitted trajectory horizon. Incomplete paths route to Ch'en for revalidation.
Poincaré-Hopf consistency: the sum of LocalIndex values at all FieldZeroes of V equals EulerCharacteristic(M). This constrains admissible reparameterizations of the manifold; see EulerCharacteristic.
Derived geometry only: GradientFlow does not authorize topology mutation. It is a representation geometry layer above FoldGraph B. The fold_graph.xml law representation-is-provider applies.

CDDefinition.Name: LieBracket
CDDefinition.Description:
LieBracket(X, Y, f) = X(Y(f)) − Y(X(f)).
Arguments: X, Y — vector-field operators (relation-conditioned derivations on M) f — smooth scalar test function f: M → ℝ
Measures the structural friction or alignment between two competing semantic transformations. When [X,Y] = 0 the two operations commute: applying @requires then @imports reaches the same geometric address regardless of order. When [X,Y] ≠ 0 the order changes the output address; this encodes asymmetric relational pairings such as @causes/@contradicts as structural curl across the vector space.
Admissibility constraint: LieBracket is a measurement/diagnostic operator. It can detect non-commuting flow friction and emit that evidence to the scoring pipeline; it cannot itself authorize eligibility or mutate FoldGraph B.

property.description: Definition: [X,Y](f) = X(Y(f)) − Y(X(f))
Antisymmetry: [X,Y] = −[Y,X]. Swapping the two operators negates the bracket.
Jacobi identity: [X,[Y,Z]] + [Y,[Z,X]] + [Z,[X,Y]] = 0. Structural consistency is preserved under triple-operator composition; no semantic torsion can escape the closed Lie algebra.
Commuting flows ([X,Y]=0): the two relation-channel traversals are path-independent. Example: @requires then @imports reaches the same geometric address as @imports then @requires.

Non-commuting friction ([X,Y]≠0): the order of semantic context changes the output address. Example: @causes then @contradicts ≠ @contradicts then @causes — the bracket is the signed curl magnitude of this asymmetric pairing.

Diagnostic only: LieBracket emits friction evidence to Ch'en scoring. It cannot authorize eligibility. Entropy may recommend; entropy may never authorize — the same constraint applies to bracket measurements.

CDDefinition.Name: ConditionalProbability
CDDefinition.Description: ConditionalProbability(w_i, context) is used for structural n-gram reset laws at sentence, paragraph, article, or section boundaries.

CDDefinition.Name: StructuralBoundaryReset
CDDefinition.Description: StructuralBoundaryReset maps a boundary delimiter (for example ◄/s► or ◄par►) to a local context reset. It prevents n-gram windows from bleeding across incompatible structural layers unless an admitted boundary transition exists.

CDDefinition.Name: DifferentiableCurve
CDDefinition.Description: DifferentiableCurve(gamma,I,X) asserts gamma:I→X, a one-dimensional differentiable trajectory used to project token, gram, sentence, or paragraph progression over learned VECTOR-µ geometry.

CDDefinition.Name: TangentVelocity
CDDefinition.Description: TangentVelocity(gamma,t)=d gamma(t)/dt. It is the local direction of semantic drift in the tangent space at gamma(t).

CDDefinition.Name: SemanticDisplacement
CDDefinition.Description: SemanticDisplacement is the derived DeltaF_curve obtained by integrating a velocity field along a differentiable trajectory. It is a projection quantity, not a topology commit.

CDDefinition.Name: TrajectoryLineIntegral
CDDefinition.Description: TrajectoryLineIntegral(gamma,V)=∫_gamma V(s)·ds.

CDDefinition.Name: CurveCurvature
CDDefinition.Description: CurveCurvature(gamma,t)=kappa(t), a nonnegative local bend measure used to mark structural inflections such as paragraph or article boundaries.

CDDefinition.Name: ScalarPotential
CDDefinition.Description: ScalarPotential(f,x) returns f(x), a projection-side potential surface used by Euclidean gradient providers. It must not be confused with semantic truth.

CDDefinition.Name: EuclideanGradient
CDDefinition.Description: EuclideanGradient(f,x)=nabla f(x) in flat R^n with g_ij=delta_ij.

CDDefinition.Name: ConservativeLineIntegral
CDDefinition.Description: ConservativeLineIntegral(gamma,grad f)=f(gamma(b))-f(gamma(a)) for flat conservative Euclidean gradient fields.

CDDefinition.Name: ZeroCurlConstraint
CDDefinition.Description: ZeroCurlConstraint(V) requires ∂V_i/∂x_j = ∂V_j/∂x_i for Euclidean gradient fields, equivalent to curl(grad f)=0.

CDDefinition.Name: LieDerivative
CDDefinition.Description: LieDerivative(X,T) measures change of a scalar, vector, or tensor field T along vector field X. It is a projection-side context drift operator.

CDDefinition.Name: ProviderParameters
CDDefinition.Description: ProviderParameters(phi) denotes learnable parameters owned by a projection provider such as VECTOR-µ, METRIC-µ, GRAPH-µ, SDR-µ, or SCX. These parameters tune geometry and indexes, not semantic truth.

CDDefinition.Name: ProjectionLoss
CDDefinition.Description: ProjectionLoss(L_total) is the provider-training objective assembled from contrastive, bridge, differential, and risk terms.

CDDefinition.Name: TrainingGradient
CDDefinition.Description: TrainingGradient(phi,L)=∇_phi L. It is a provider-learning signal and is not a FoldDelta.

CDDefinition.Name: GradientNorm
CDDefinition.Description: GradientNorm(g)=||g||, a nonnegative magnitude used for telemetry and clipping.

CDDefinition.Name: GradientClip
CDDefinition.Description: GradientClip(g,c) bounds a training gradient by positive clip threshold c.

CDDefinition.Name: ParameterUpdate
CDDefinition.Description: ParameterUpdate(phi,eta,g)=phi-eta*g. It updates provider parameters only; it does not commit FoldGraph topology.

CDDefinition.Name: ShannonEntropy
CDDefinition.Description: ShannonEntropy(P,x) = -sum_w P(w|x) log P(w|x), the local uncertainty of the admitted token/gram distribution at projection coordinate x.

CDDefinition.Name: EntropyGradient
CDDefinition.Description: EntropyGradient(H,x)=nabla H(x), the direction of steepest change in local uncertainty. It supports exploration and repair gating, not semantic truth.

CDDefinition.Name: EntropySpike
CDDefinition.Description: EntropySpike(DeltaH) records a nonnegative jump in structural uncertainty.

CDDefinition.Name: EntropyBound
CDDefinition.Description: EntropyBound(H,Hmax) asserts H is within an admitted entropy ceiling.

CDDefinition.Name: FreeEnergyFlow
CDDefinition.Description: FreeEnergyFlow(f,H,beta,x) = -nabla f(x) + beta^-1 nabla H(x), combining relevance drift with entropy-gradient diffusion.

CDDefinition.Name: FokkerPlanckFlow
CDDefinition.Description: FokkerPlanckFlow(rho,f,beta) denotes partial_t rho = div(rho nabla f) + beta^-1 Delta rho for projection-density evolution.

CDDefinition.Name: DiffusionScale
CDDefinition.Description: DiffusionScale(beta_inv)=beta^-1, a nonnegative entropy diffusion factor.

CDDefinition.Name: GeodesicEntropy
CDDefinition.Description: GeodesicEntropy(v) = -sum_{u!=v} p(d(v,u)) * log(p(d(v,u))) where p(d) = |{u : d(v,u)=d}| / (|V|-1). Measures Shannon uncertainty of the shortest-path distance distribution from node v. Low value = central hub (trajectory concentrates); High value = scattered region (signal diffuses globally). Derived geometry only; cannot mutate FoldGraph B.

CDDefinition.Name: TriangularEntropy
CDDefinition.Description: TriangularEntropy(T) = -sum_{sigma in T} w(sigma) * log(w(sigma)) where T is a set of 2-simplices (3-node closed triangles) and w(sigma) is the normalized simplex_weight for face sigma. Low value = stable equilateral mesh (symmetric relation verbs); High value = warped/mismatched triangles signaling local structural decomposition. Monitoring tool for the Factory; diagnostic only — cannot authorize topology commits.

CDDefinition.Name: Circumradius
CDDefinition.Description: Circumradius(T)=R is the radius of the circumscribed circle for a local inscribed semantic triangle T. It is projection geometry over FoldGraph B, not semantic authority.

CDDefinition.Name: Inradius
CDDefinition.Description: Inradius(T)=r is the incircle radius of the local semantic compression core inside triangle T. It is diagnostic projection geometry only.

CDDefinition.Name: Circumcenter
CDDefinition.Description: Circumcenter(T)=O is the coordinate center of the circumcircle. Drift between O and a local mesh average indicates projection stress, not a verified semantic mutation.

CDDefinition.Name: EulerTriangleInequality
CDDefinition.Description: EulerTriangleInequality(T) asserts Circumradius(T) >= 2*Inradius(T) for the local inscribed triangle. Violations indicate warped projection mesh geometry and cannot by themselves alter FoldGraph B.

CDDefinition.Name: RaychaudhuriFlow
CDDefinition.Description: RaychaudhuriFlow(H_G, gamma, t) = dH_G/dt = sum_{e in gamma} (R_{mu nu} u^mu u^nu + (1/3)*theta^2). Geodesic entropy production rate along streamline gamma as a function of Ricci curvature focusing and expansion squared. Finite-time focusing prevents infinite entropic diffusion; Ch'en checks the integral bound. Derived geometry only.

CDDefinition.Name: PropagatorKernel
CDDefinition.Description: PropagatorKernel(x, y, tau) = sum_{gamma in Paths(x,y)} exp(-S[gamma]) where S[gamma] = integral_0^tau (1/2 * g_{ij} * x_dot^i * x_dot^j + U(x)) dt is the Lagrangian action over curved metric g. Each GPU thread evaluates one incident edge amplitude; reduction over all edges yields total path-integral flux at the target node. Feeds geodesic_entropy update: H_G = -log(total_flux / node_count). Derived geometry only; cannot authorize eligibility or mutate FoldGraph B.

CDDefinition.Name: MicronautAttraction
CDDefinition.Description: MicronautAttraction(mu,Q)=Phi_mu(Q)=MicronautMass(mu) * GeometricAlignment(Q,MicronautKeyVector(mu)) * WCRPrior(mu). It is the projection-side attraction score for routing an unfolded query trajectory into a phase-scoped Micronaut basin. It gates candidate capture only and cannot verify semantic truth, rewrite RelationISA, or commit FoldGraph B.

CDDefinition.Name: MicronautMass
CDDefinition.Description: MicronautMass(mu) is the derived density of a Micronaut attractor basin, typically assembled from forward co-occurrence mass M_{Y,X}, declared governs/tokens neighborhoods, folds, and static_weight metadata. It is representation evidence, not an authoritative fact.

CDDefinition.Name: MicronautKeyVector
CDDefinition.Description: MicronautKeyVector(mu)=K_mu denotes the vector_meta or coordinate anchor for a Micronaut in TENSOR-µ projection geometry. Changing K_mu changes the projection, not the semantic identity of the Micronaut.

CDDefinition.Name: GeometricAlignment
CDDefinition.Description: GeometricAlignment(Q,K_mu)=cos(Q,K_mu) or an equivalent provider-specific angular/metric alignment score. It supplies relevance geometry only.

CDDefinition.Name: WCRPrior
CDDefinition.Description: WCRPrior(mu)=W_mu*C_mu*R_mu combines static selection weight, operational/epistemic confidence, and provider relevance for a Micronaut. WCR qualifies routing; it does not establish proof.

CDDefinition.Name: EntropyDiffusion
CDDefinition.Description: EntropyDiffusion(mu) is the local exploratory uncertainty pressure that a Micronaut attraction score must overbalance before capture is admitted.

CDDefinition.Name: CaptureGate
CDDefinition.Description: CaptureGate(Q,mu) admits a query trajectory into a Micronaut execution sandbox when MicronautAttraction(mu,Q) overbalances EntropyDiffusion(mu) and policy_ok, capability, and XCFE authorization all hold. Capture is not Ch'en verification and is not Xul persistence.

CDDefinition.Name: PolicyOk
CDDefinition.Description: PolicyOk(mu,Q) asserts that the Micronaut sandbox/policy boundary admits the candidate operation for query Q.

CDDefinition.Name: CapabilityOk
CDDefinition.Description: CapabilityOk(mu,Q) asserts that the Micronaut exposes the capability needed by the candidate operation.

CDDefinition.Name: XcfeOk
CDDefinition.Description: XcfeOk(mu,Q) asserts that XCFE move algebra authorizes the capture/dispatch transition for the current phase.

CDDefinition.Name: TensorField
CDDefinition.Description: TensorField(M,p,q) assigns a type-(p,q) tensor to each admitted coordinate point over the projection manifold M. In KHANARY this is TENSOR-µ derived geometry over FoldGraph B; it cannot verify semantic truth or mutate B.

CDDefinition.Name: TensorRank
CDDefinition.Description: TensorRank(T)=(p,q), where p is the contravariant rank and q is the covariant rank. Ranks are nonnegative integers and are carried in GML as tensor_rank_p and tensor_rank_q.

CDDefinition.Name: MetricTensor
CDDefinition.Description: MetricTensor(g_ij) is the local covariant bilinear form used by TENSOR-µ to measure projection distance, raise/lower indices, and evaluate local tensor geometry. It is a projection metric, not RelationISA authority.

CDDefinition.Name: JacobianMatrix
CDDefinition.Description: JacobianMatrix(J) carries partial derivatives dx^{i'}/dx^i for coordinate transitions between projection generations or local charts.

CDDefinition.Name: InverseJacobian
CDDefinition.Description: InverseJacobian(J^{-1}) carries partial derivatives dx^j/dx^{j'} and is applied to lower/covariant tensor indices during coordinate transition.

CDDefinition.Name: TensorTransform
CDDefinition.Description: TensorTransform(T,J,J^{-1}) enforces the coordinate-independent tensor law: upper indices transform by the Jacobian and lower indices transform by the inverse Jacobian. For type-(1,1), T^{i'}_{j'} = T^i_j * (dx^{i'}/dx^i) * (dx^j/dx^{j'}).

CDDefinition.Name: SmoothSection
CDDefinition.Description: SmoothSection(T) marks a tensor field as admitted to smooth-section projection checks. The parser flag is_smooth_section is declarative projection metadata and does not by itself prove semantic truth.

CDDefinition.Name: TensorBundle
CDDefinition.Description: TensorBundle(M)=direct_sum_{p,q} (TM)^tensor_p tensor (T*M)^tensor_q. KHANARY instantiates bounded projection slices of this bundle through TensorSubstrate and TENSOR-µ; B remains the semantic topology authority.

CDDefinition.Name: CoordinateTransition
CDDefinition.Description: CoordinateTransition(chart_a,chart_b) is a projection-generation or local-chart change mediated by JacobianMatrix and InverseJacobian. A coordinate transition may realign geometry without implying Delta(B).

CDDefinition.Name: LogicalConsequence
CDDefinition.Description: LogicalConsequence(Sigma,phi) asserts that phi follows from the currently verified non-logical axiom base Sigma under the primary KHANARY laws. It is a semantic claim and must not be supplied by projection geometry alone.

CDDefinition.Name: DeductiveProofTrace
CDDefinition.Description: DeductiveProofTrace(Sigma,phi) is the phase-scoped evidence trail showing how phi is derived from Sigma through admitted K'UHUL inference moves. It is required before a logical consequence claim can be exposed as SUPPORTED.

CDDefinition.Name: MissState
CDDefinition.Description: MissState(Sigma,phi) records an observation or retrieval deficit: Sigma currently proves neither phi nor not-phi. MISS preserves unresolved branches and is not CONTRADICTED without separate negative evidence.

CDDefinition.Name: MinkowskiBilinearForm
CDDefinition.Description: MinkowskiBilinearForm(u,v) is the invariant bilinear projection used by hyperbolic key-grammar events. The default signature is (-,+,+,+): B(u,v)=-u0*v0+u1*v1+u2*v2+u3*v3. It is routing geometry and cannot by itself establish semantic truth.

CDDefinition.Name: HyperbolicDistance
CDDefinition.Description: HyperbolicDistance(u,v)=arcosh(-MinkowskiBilinearForm(u,v)) on the admitted future sheet. It provides non-Euclidean distance for event projections, not topology authority.

CDDefinition.Name: HyperbolicEvent
CDDefinition.Description: HyperbolicEvent(origin,key,rho,direction,interval_class) records a future-directed key-grammar candidate continuation. Ch'en verifies any semantic claim derived from it before Xul may commit.

CDDefinition.Name: Rapidity
CDDefinition.Description: Rapidity(rho) is the additive hyperbolic displacement parameter used for token or gram event progression across a local Minkowski substrate.

CDDefinition.Name: MinkowskiIntervalClass
CDDefinition.Description: MinkowskiIntervalClass partitions event intervals into timelike candidate, lightlike boundary, spacelike candidate, or unclassified states. The class gates routing admissibility and does not assert fact authority.

CDDefinition.Name: EinsteinContraction
CDDefinition.Description: EinsteinContraction(index, A, v) denotes implicit summation over the repeated upper/lower index pair. For the common type-(1,1) matrix-vector projection, u^i = A^i_j v^j. In KHANARY this is used by shader backends for coordinate-frame projection and does not verify semantic truth.

CDDefinition.Name: LorentzFrameTransition
CDDefinition.Description: LorentzFrameTransition(L,v) applies the row-contracted boost matrix L^i_j to a hyperbolic event four-vector v^j. The result is a transformed projection coordinate u^i for TENSOR-µ routing; Ch'en/Xul still control verification and persistence.

CDDefinition.Name: LorentzBoostTensor
CDDefinition.Description: LorentzBoostTensor(rho,n) constructs the type-(1,1) Lorentz transition matrix L^i_j from rapidity rho and spatial direction n. It must preserve the Minkowski bilinear form under EinsteinContraction; it is routing geometry only and cannot establish semantic authority.

CDDefinition.Name: SemanticSignature
CDDefinition.Description: SemanticSignature(F,B) denotes the immutable constructor and relation-verb signature induced by the current Fold topology B. Interpretation algebras may project or collapse neighborhoods over this signature, but they cannot rewrite F without a verified Xul topology commit.

CDDefinition.Name: Neighborhood
CDDefinition.Description: Neighborhood(k) returns the local semantic neighborhood around key or coordinate k: nodes, incident relation edges, and typed constructor context. It is the input structure for algebraic folds and remains distinct from the target-domain value produced by an interpretation algebra.

CDDefinition.Name: AlgebraicFold
CDDefinition.Description: AlgebraicFold(alpha,N,theta) applies the active interpretation algebra alpha to semantic neighborhood N under K'UHUL phase theta. This is the catamorphic fold operation: it maps structure into a target domain while preserving the underlying signature F.

CDDefinition.Name: XulCollapse
CDDefinition.Description: XulCollapse(value) denotes the final collapse of a verified fold result into a retained key, fingerprint, route, or admitted topology proposal. It requires the normal Ch'en/XCFE/Xul authority path and is not granted by projection geometry alone.

CDDefinition.Name: SignatureIsomorphism
CDDefinition.Description: SignatureIsomorphism(F_base,F_transformed) asserts that an interpretation functor preserved constructor identity, edge connectivity, and relational rank invariants between the source signature and transformed projection.

CDDefinition.Name: MatrixRank
CDDefinition.Description: MatrixRank(T) returns the structural rank used by the validator to compare transformed tensor projections against their substrate representation.

CDDefinition.Name: FoldField

property.description: score() = W · C · R; multiplicative, not additive
theta is set by phase_angle(Phase) for the canonical C6 phases; arbitrary theta is permitted for intermediate projection states

CDDefinition.Name: ProductGraph
CDDefinition.Description:
ProductGraph(G_semantic, G_phase) = G_semantic □ G_phase = G_runtime.
Vertices: (node_id, phase) pairs from the Cartesian product of semantic nodes and C6 phase positions.
Edge weight: W_arc(i,j) · cos(θ_j − θ_i), where W_arc is the semantic arc weight from G_semantic and cos(Δθ) is the phase coherence term from G_phase. The product graph formalizes G_runtime = G_semantic □ G_phase as established in the hylomorphism synthesis.

property.description: Edge weight ∈ [−1, 1] when W_arc ∈ [0, 1]
FoldField is a vertex; fold_relevance() is the approximate edge weight when W_arc is not directly available

CDDefinition.Name: FoldRelevance
CDDefinition.Description:
FoldRelevance(a, b) is the approximate edge weight between two FoldField vertices in G_runtime:
fold_relevance(a, b) = √(W_a · W_b) · √(C_a · C_b) · cos(θ_b − θ_a)
Returns a value in [−1, 1] when W, C ∈ [0, 1]. Self-relevance: fold_relevance(a, a) = W · C.
Exact form when arc weight is known: fold_relevance(a, b, W_arc) = W_arc · √(C_a · C_b) · cos(θ_b − θ_a)
Negative W_arc is clamped to 0 (no physical meaning for negative arc weight).

property.description: Symmetric: fold_relevance(a,b) = fold_relevance(b,a)
Orthogonal phases (Δθ = π/2): fold_relevance = 0
Antipodal phases (Δθ = π): fold_relevance negative — incoherent alignment

CDDefinition.Name: ConvergenceTest
CDDefinition.Description:
ConvergenceTest(epsilon, k_max, max_iter, div_window) tracks the Kleene iteration f^n(query) over FoldStates.
Status transitions: ITERATING → initial state and normal progress CONVERGED → d_n < epsilon (fixed point reached within tolerance) MAX_ITER → n ≥ max_iter (hard stop) DIVERGING → k = d_n/d_{n-1} ≥ k_max for div_window consecutive steps
Fields: FoldState.field — 256D L1-normalised semantic field FoldState.wcr_scores — (micronaut_id, score) pairs fold_distance — alpha * L1(field)/2 + (1-alpha) * mean_abs_dev(wcr) best_state() — FoldState at minimum observed d
Identity invariant: when d_last < 1e-9 (first step after identity state), k_last = 0 (avoids division-by-zero, CONVERGED immediately).

property.description: Kleene fixed point: µf = ⊔{f^n(⊥) | n≥0}. Xul is the least fixed point of the Micronaut hylomorphism.
Banach contraction: k < 1 guarantees unique fixed point; k ≥ k_max for div_window steps → DIVERGING

CDDefinition.Name: IdentityInvariant
CDDefinition.Description:
IdentityInvariant asserts (Fold∘Unfold)(h) ≡ h: a round-trip hylomorphism returns the original handle without loss.
In the K'UHUL pipeline: Unfold(h) produces the active field F_Q. Fold(F_Q) collapses back to a canonical handle. The composition must recover h.
Violation: if (Fold∘Unfold)(h) ≠ h, the structural sigma drops to UNBOUND and the state requires Ch'en revalidation before further Xul commits.
In ConvergenceTest: two consecutive identical FoldStates → d = 0 → k = 0 → CONVERGED on the second step, confirming the identity invariant holds.

property.description: (Fold∘Unfold)(h) ≡ h is a necessary condition for topology-preserving semantic navigation

CDDefinition.Name: HylomorphismStep
CDDefinition.Description:
HylomorphismStep(f, query, n) = f^n(query), one Kleene iteration of the Micronaut hylomorphism f = cata∘ana.
ana (anamorphism / coalgebra): query → F(wildcards, tail) Unfolds the query into a structured active field. AnaWildcard generator: text → AIML wildcard priority stack.
cata (catamorphism / algebra): F(wildcards, tail) → Xul Folds the active field into a canonical result. Xul is the catamorphic result = least fixed point.
Repeated application f^n(query) converges to µf under the Banach contraction condition tracked by ConvergenceTest.

property.description: Termination: AnaWildcard tail strictly shrinks at each ana step; the unfold always terminates
f = cata∘ana is a hylomorphism; the Micronaut pipeline is the Kleene iteration of f
